title: Package manifest with no tools version
description: Package.swift declares a manifest that declares no Swift tools version. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a manifest that declares no Swift tools version.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a manifest that declares no Swift tools version.
limitation: It matches a manifest that declares no Swift tools version in the parsed Package.swift; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
